name: log4j
description: Apache Log4j across a version x config x app matrix, on real JVMs
writesNote: No verb here writes upstream. `hub` only serves and writes a local page; the one path that can POST is guarded inside hub.py at api_post, which refuses unless the hub was started with --approve-upstream <repo> AND the repository name is retyped for that specific send. Listing `hub` here as a write blocked merely VIEWING the page, which sends nothing.
verbsNote: Reading a pull request or an issue is `oss pr` / `oss issue`, and following one is `oss followup` / `oss hub` -- none of those need a clone, so none are here. What is kept is what needs this bench: `pr` reports which log4j-* modules a diff lands in and `--checkout/--install` publishes the branch as a SNAPSHOT the matrix can select; `run`, `matrix` and `repro` fork real JVMs.
packNote: This manifest exists because the ENGINE currently lives here. A pack is data -- axes, applications, configurations -- and has no exec to declare. When `bench` moves to the core, this file goes with it and what remains is the playground: packs/, apps/, configs/, log4j-samples/.
